Iran suspends US ceasefire deal, citing American violations

Iran has announced it is suspending a ceasefire deal with the US, citing violations of commitments by the United States. The move comes amid heightened tensions and follows a US threat to strike a location referred to as "Pickaxe Mountain". The exact nature of the deal and the implications of its suspension remain subjects of discussion.
